content.introduction: The United States Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August 2026 was 334.98 points, with an annual inflation rate of 3.4%, according to Wikipedia. The CPI for September 2026 is expected to be 3.4% year-over-year, according to Trading Economics. The CPI-U level for August 2026 was 334.980 with a headline inflation of 3.4% year-over-year, and core inflation of 2.4% year-over-year, according to Wikipedia. The CPI for January 2026 was 2.7% year-over-year, according to Investing.com.
body:
## Consumer Price Index CPI in the United States increased to 334.98 points in August 2026 from 333.92 points the previous month. The annual inflation rate in the US steadied at 3.4%, the same as in July and in line with forecasts. Gasoline prices rose 27.4% yoy, slightly more than 24.6% in July and fuel oil prices increased 52%, compared with 39.1% previously. On the other hand, inflation eased for shelter, to 3% from 3.2%, and for food to 2.7% from 3%. On a monthly basis, the CPI rose 0.4%, [...] ### Consumer Price Index CPI in the United States is expected to be 335.07 points by the end of this quarter, according to Trading Economics global macro models and analysts expectations. In the long-term, the United States Consumer Price Index (CPI) is projected to trend around 343.78 points in 2027 and 352.38 points in 2028, according to our econometric models.
